P8.doc: Storage exhaustion: a journal with a hard size limit. Does the gateway refuse before it
P8.refusal: storage.exhausted: the journal is within its critical reserve of its size limit (2097152 of 3145728 bytes used), so nothing was sent; new commands and reads ar
P8.read_when_full: GatewayError: [storage.exhausted] the journal is within its critical reserve of its size limit (2097152 of 3145728 bytes used), so not

P1b.doc: Does a changed Thing Description change the contract hash recorded at registration?
P1b.reading: same description, same hash; any change to the description changes the recorded hash. Hashes truncated to 16 hex characters here. Run by hand with the importer's command-line path (the benchmark harness builds manifests directly and does not add the source record).
P1b.note_on_P1: P1's td_source_in_contract is null because the experiment harness does not use the importer's command line
